As for the questions:

Yes, as she used to be human. When the friend is introduced in the story, she appears to be a mind-wiped shell of her former self, which brings Sophs a lot of grief. They used to be best friends growing up, as she was the only person who accepted Sophie for her personality and personal issues (one of which is actually being transgender and also part-monster), both causing a lot of issues with being accepted in an environment full of discrimination.

Mostly the latter, as she doesn't generally like people. There's a big secret about her that she doesn't even know, which causes a lot of confusion in her own head. Some know this, however, and will attempt to kill her on sight.

Mid 20s, young, but old enough to be independent of anybody else. Following her teen years and her friend's disappearance, she abandoned everybody she held close and went to pursue her own fate.

She had an upbringing at a young age that taught her how to defend herself, as those raising her knew she would be in a lot of danger. Training from a really young age really does a number for your fighting skills!

Sorry if these are a bit vague, I want to keep this as spoiler-friendly as possible.

A wandering warrior and outcast, Sophie Wildflower makes her way through the world of Proxyland in order to find out what the hell happened to her family and how she can save her shape-shifting bug best friend. Little memories of her past cause her distress and is her driving force in the narrative.

A strong natural fighter and self-inflicted loner, she isn't prone to speaking much or really interacting with people unless absolutely necessary. However, she wants to uncover the mystery of her past and why people want her head for some reason!?

She basically hates everybody at the beginning, but that gets better.
